title: Asset registry
description: manifest/assets.json: an array of asset records covering placeholders shipped with layouts and real images bound into slides.

id.description: Stable asset id, used by element spec strings and by bundle manifests.

kind.description: What the asset is. Placeholders are the grey stand-ins shipped with layouts.
kind.$comment: No vocab file: asset kinds are manifest-internal and never appear in frontmatter.

alt.description: Alt text; also the caption default.

source.description: Where the asset came from, or "-" for repo-generated placeholders.

license.description: License or usage note. Public-repo assets must be redistributable (Decision 4).

canva_asset_id.description: Asset id returned by upload-asset-from-url. Quoted string so PowerShell never coerces it to Int64 (research/06 §e). "-" when not uploaded.

used_by.description: Layout ids and slide paths that reference this asset.
